Put your built .rom images in this folder (copyrighted; not included).

Each supported set has a .mra recipe here. Build one with the MAME romset
of the same name:

    mra bombjack.mra        writes bombjack.rom
    mra bombjack2.mra       writes bombjack2.rom

Sets: bombjack, bombjack2, bombjackt, bombjackbl.

The three clones are split sets, so keep the parent bombjack.zip alongside
the clone zip when building them.

Keep the .rom files in this folder and on your Pocket SD card, then pick the
game from the core's menu.
